'''Raviel Tyrrus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SlicerMaleTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Raviel Tyrrus]]
[[File:SlicerFemTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated female depictions, deemed non-canon in Legends continuity]]
Raviel Tyrrus was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Raviel Tyrrus spawned under the generic "slicer" template, his appearance was randomized under one of eight possible depictions. He could either appear as four different types of Human males, or as four different types of Human females. Because the quest dialogue identified Tyrrus as a male, this article assumes that one of the four Human male depictions are [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="AED" />
